title: Grid Dynamics Expands Global Footprint with JUXT Acquisition, Strengthening Expertise in Banking and Financial Services
summary: San Ramon, Calif., September 26, 2024 – Grid Dynamics Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: GDYN) (Grid Dynamics), a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and digital engagement services, today announces its acquisition of JUXT, a UK-based provider of software engineering services specializing in data-intensive information systems for banking and other financial institutions, with a particular focus on risk platforms, structured notes, equity derivatives, and financial reporting. With this acquisition, Grid Dynamics adds significant expertise and capabilities to better serve enterprise clients in the financial services industry.
